newsitem.title: ITALY: Minimum rate 7.09 pct at Italy lira repo tender.
newsitem.headline: Minimum rate 7.09 pct at Italy lira repo tender.

text.p: The minimum rate at today's 9.0 trillion lire four-day Bank of Italy repurchase tender was 7.09 percent, compared with 7.08 percent at the previous repo tender on April 23, the Bank said.
The average rate was 7.11 percent against 7.09 percent at the last repurchase pact for 6.0 trillion lire and nine days.
The pact covers purchases today and the securities are for resale on May 2. The Bank said it received 28 bids of which 12 were met in full and seven in part.
